posts.author: Banana_Duck
posts.body:
Hello to everyone, my name is Banana Duck, or Banane Canard in my native language (French). I like watching YouTube essays and top tens, listening to loud music, reading myths and legends, and hilariously bad media.
I'm also a budding music producer who, before starting music in 2024, had ambitions to create stories that remained unfulfilled because of a lack of a focused goal.
Until now.
In late July, I picked up RPG Maker VX Ace for the first time since MV's release with one ambition: actually making and releasing a game. Yes, despite using various RM programs for years, I never came close to making a game, I was the kind of duck who would mess with scripts until I have too many of these and never had a solid concept in my head beyond "lol random". I was, and still am, easily distracted by things like scripts/plugins, and despite being inspired by all kinds of pop culture, I had zero idea on how my story would go.
But now, things are different. I now have a proper story to tell, proper characters to write about, good enough drawing and music skills, and ideas on how my game will play like. I know what scenes to write about, I know what concepts to include.
Focus!
